zh-CN.title: 司马承祯
zh-CN.subtitle: 道教上清传统的代表人物
zh-CN.shortSummary: 司马承祯连接山林修炼、道教法脉与唐代皇室对宗教人物的吸纳。
curatorialDescription: 司马承祯让我们看到，道教并不是抽象的哲学标签，也不是单一的宫廷制度，而是由人物、山岳、法脉、经典和皇室关系共同组成的历史网络。
他的条目需要同时呈现历史活动、传统身份和后世记忆，不能只用一条生平年份替代复杂的传统时间。
zh-CN.researchNote: 本条目为 Alpha 结构化样本，后续需要补充法脉、宫观和具体诏见记录的版本化来源。

en.title: Sima Chengzhen
en.subtitle: A representative figure of the Shangqing Daoist tradition
en.shortSummary: Sima Chengzhen connects mountain cultivation, Daoist lineages and Tang imperial patronage.
curatorialDescription: Sima Chengzhen shows why Daoism cannot be reduced either to an abstract philosophy or to a single court institution. It was a historical network of people, mountains, lineages, texts and imperial relationships.
His entry must distinguish documented activity, traditional identity and later memory rather than replacing this complexity with one biographical date.
en.researchNote: This Alpha structured sample still needs versioned references for lineage, institutions and court encounters.
